'''Vansic''' was a [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]]. As of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he run his own shop, [[Vansic's Scrap & Trade Market]], in the hidden [[Aurilia|Township of Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vansic appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
